summary: On-demand tenant activity ledger CSV with redaction map, timezone-normalized timestamps, and HMAC index for compliance review
description:
Issue summary:
Customer (Atlas Bank, enterprise tier) requests an on-demand CSV export of the tenant activity ledger for a two-week window (2026-02-20 to 2026-03-05) with the following requirements: timezone-normalized ISO8601 timestamps (UTC), a redaction map that lists original->pseudonym token mapping for PII fields, per-row HMAC index for tamper-evidence (HMAC-SHA256, customer-provided key derivation info), and a short resume token for incremental replay. The deliverable must be suitable for ingestion into their SIEM and for legal review.

Impact:
- Customer cannot complete compliance evidence package for upcoming audit until they receive canonical CSV and redaction mapping.
- Customer reports they will halt internal sign-off if the file is delayed more than 48 hours.

Environment:
- Production tenant: atlas-bank-prod
- Region: us-east primary, requested mirror for eu-west as secondary copy
- Expected volume: ~1.2M activity rows (two-week slice), maybe 4-6 GB compressed CSV

Request details (customer-specified):
1) CSV format: UTF-8, comma-separated, newline-escaped fields, header row using canonical audit field names (event_id, tenant_id, user_pseudonym, event_type, model_id, input_tokens, output_tokens, timestamp_utc, request_id, context_hash).
2) Redaction map: CSV mapping original_id -> pseudonym_id for fields flagged as PII (user_id, email) with a short justification column for each mapping and a per-field pseudonymization salt fingerprint. Customer expects reversible mapping proof (HSM-attested flow not required — they will accept salted pseudonym map exported under secure transfer).
3) Timestamps: all normalized to UTC ISO8601 with millisecond precision; include original timezone column if available.
4) HMAC index: per-row HMAC-SHA256 over concatenated (event_id||timestamp_utc||tenant_id) with hex digest; include a manifest file describing algorithm and key-derivation/proof-of-possession steps.
5) Delivery: SFTP transfer to customer-managed host (host details provided via secure form), with MD5 and SHA256 checksums for archive.

Steps to reproduce / how we verified initial slice availability:
- Support ran an internal query for atlas-bank-prod over 2026-02-20..2026-03-05 against the audit-archive index and confirmed ~1.18M rows (query id audit-q-20260312-7).
- Confirmed redaction-service has pseudonymization artifacts for tenant (pseudomap-tenant-ATLAS-2025.v2).

Attachments provided by customer:
- Signed upload form with SFTP host and contact (attachments/atlas_sftp_details.pdf)
steps_to_reproduce: Run audit-archive query for tenant 'atlas-bank-prod' between 2026-02-20 and 2026-03-05 (query id: audit-q-20260312-7).
Confirm pseudomap exists at internal path /secure/pseudomaps/pseudomap-tenant-ATLAS-2025.v2.
Attempt CSV export using current on-demand export job template with timezone-normalization flag and hmac-index option.
investigation_notes: 2026-03-12 10:15Z: Support performed dry-run export for a 24-hour subset (2026-02-21) to validate schema; output matches header conventions but HMAC column missing when export invoked without --hmac flag.
2026-03-12 11:03Z: Noted that current on-demand export CLI requires new flag --include-redaction-map which is behind feature flag fd/redaction-map; feature flag disabled in prod for safety.
2026-03-12 12:40Z: Engineering (SRE) confirmed quota for concurrent export jobs in us-east is available; estimated full export runtime 3-5 hours with streaming compression.
comments: 2026-03-12 13:05Z - Asha Patel (Support): Acknowledged ticket and requested SFTP public key and preferred filename convention.
2026-03-12 13:27Z - Atlas Bank (customer): Uploaded SFTP public key via secure intake and confirmed they need HMAC in hex and include original_timezone column.
2026-03-12 15:50Z - Liam O'Connor (SRE): Flagged that fd/redaction-map must be enabled and PR #1824 contains the change; PR is in review and needs a small schema doc update.
2026-03-12 18:12Z - Asha Patel (Support): Notified customer that export is blocked until feature-flag approval; asked for audit escrow SLA waiver form if they need a temporary workaround.
action_items: Enable fd/redaction-map for atlas-bank-prod for this export only (SRE runbook step).

Perform full two-week export with --timezone-normalize --include-redaction-map --hmac parameters and stream to gzip archive.
- Verify row count against query id audit-q-20260312-7.
- Produce manifest.json describing HMAC algorithm and field order (customer asked for this file).
Coordinate SFTP transfer and verify checksums on customer side; capture delivery receipts.
Post-export: create a short compliance note (1 page) describing pseudomap provenance and retention rules and attach to ticket.
workarounds: Customer offered to accept a temporary split export: pseudomap + 48-hour CSV slices delivered immediately, then remaining slices delivered within 24 hours after fd/redaction-map is enabled.
expected_delivery_estimate: 2026-03-13 (subject to feature-flag enablement and SRE window)
customer_communication_plan: Notify customer within 2 hours of flag enablement and provide ETA for transfer start.
Send transfer receipts and checksum verification within 1 hour of completion.
Attach compliance note and retention mapping within 24 hours post-transfer.
